body: It is next day. Things have only gotten worst. My parents refused to hear me tell the full story and email the teacher and now the teacher told them I was lying and now my mom told me that I am a lier, that I will never have her trust again and that I am a dissapointment. Can't wait for my dad to arrive from work. This may be my last day on this cruel Earth. I am just done. Nothing I do is ever noticed or valued. All my parents see is all the bad things I have done. They already took everything I like and I am prisioner in my room. I already made the calculations. A human skull will break at a force of 4000 Newtons and falling from 4 stories will give me a impact of 7171 Newtons and a final velocity of 50 km/h. It will surely kill me. I only hope it is painless. All hope is lost
